recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast minimalist composition featuring a person's arm raised from the bottom right, holding a white and magenta megaphone. A jagged, horizontal audio waveform bisects the lower third of the frame, serving as a container for the title text. The background is a clean, textured off-white, suggesting paper or a wall.
coreVisualRelationships: The megaphone points toward the upper right corner, creating a diagonal tension against the horizontal waveform.
The magenta accents on the megaphone and sleeve harmonize with the dark maroon of the waveform.
The waveform acts as a grounding horizon line for the vertical arm element.
coreInvariants: High-contrast silhouette-like treatment of the waveform
Off-white negative space dominating the upper two-thirds
Magenta as the primary pop color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The arm and megaphone occupy the right third, extending from the bottom edge to the top right. The waveform spans the full width in the lower third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The hand gripping the megaphone serves as the primary focal point due to its central-right placement and detail.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the hand, follow the megaphone's bell upward, then drop down to the horizontal waveform and read the text from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive off-white space in the upper left and center creates a sense of 'loudness' and clarity.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value background with low-value, high-saturation foreground elements for maximum legibility.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' has a distinct angled leg starting from the vertical stem

composition.position: Lower left, overlaid on the waveform
composition.overlap: Knocked out of the waveform shape

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for impact; no secondary pairing needed.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, squared-off industrial aesthetic.
Provides the necessary technical and expanded feel.
Similar geometric structure and modern weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a minimalist image with a textured off-white background. In the bottom third, place a horizontal, jagged dark maroon audio waveform silhouette. From the bottom right, show a person's arm in a magenta sleeve holding a white megaphone with magenta accents, pointing towards the top right corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay uppercase text in a wide, squared-off techno sans-serif font. Position the text on the left side of the maroon waveform, using a white fill so the letters appear cut out of the waveform shape.

verificationChecks: Is the text legible against the waveform?
Is the color palette restricted to off-white, maroon, and magenta?

adjustableVariables: Text alignment (left vs right within waveform)
mustRedesign: Any specific logos on the megaphone
Identifiable facial features if the person were visible

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the waveform
Consistent monolinear stroke weight in typography

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the waveform is a single solid color (maroon).
Confirm the megaphone is white with magenta accents.
Check that the font is wide and squared-off.
Verify the arm enters from the bottom right corner.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a horizontal data visualization (waveform) with a diagonal action element (arm with megaphone) using a three-color palette and technical, wide typography for an urban, communicative aesthetic.
